compatibility.advanced: three strategies, overrides, null/empty selections, references/templates/history, preferences and partial outcome remain
compatibility.cli: old public signatures and Skip/Overwrite/Merge, duplicate per-write count and kept old history remain; shared journal commit/completion
compatibility.coreService: ordinary request/result/errors and original Session/storage; no Host lock guard/Tauri/AppState/error prefix
compatibility.host: authorization, blocking scheduling, wire/error/progress; actual manual cloud setting entry included
compatibility.recovery: original pre-COMMIT handoff, activity/root/session and transport semantics retained
compatibility.journal: original source proof/options/root binding/unique mapping, accepted empty operation partial and Complete retry semantics remain
compatibility.preview: original summaries/conflicts/filter/fallback, has_audit_log=false, no business writes
compatibility.outputFaultTests: original RF017 test region exact including assertions
compatibility.sourceReview: primary agent; tokens preserve literals; no independent final review claim
compatibility.limits: local Windows fixtures/close-and-reopen only; no process crash, visible GUI, other platform or remote cloud validation claim
